# Know Your Meme & Scientific American

> > A mixed collection documenting internet culture phenomena and scientific content, primarily featuring viral memes from TikTok, exploitable formats, and subscription information.

This site appears to combine Know Your Meme's documentation of viral internet trends (particularly TikTok and social media memes) with Scientific American's subscription offerings. The content focuses heavily on contemporary meme culture, viral videos, and exploitable image formats that spread across platforms like TikTok, Twitter, and Facebook.

## Key Topics

- TikTok trends and viral videos
- Exploitable memes and image macros
- Know Your Meme documentation
- Viral catchphrases and dialogue
- Dance memes and challenges
- Social media platforms (Twitter/X, Facebook, DeviantArt)
- Pop culture references (Breaking Bad, 90s hood movies)
- Content creators (BunnaB, YKNiece, @sierra81204, t-a-t-k-a)
- Heartbreaking and nostalgia memes
- Hood culture and rap music references

## Viral Meme Documentation

- [Jesse, What the Fuck Are You Talking About](https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/jesse-what-the-fuck-are-you-talking-about): Breaking Bad dialogue meme featuring Walter White & Jesse Pinkman
- [We Still Talk About You](https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/we-still-talk-about-you): Exploitable meme featuring art of girl lying over cat, viral on TikTok
- [I'm Talking About Innit](https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/im-talking-about-innit): TikTok dance trend based on BunnaB & YKNiece's 'Innit' with swimming gesture

## Meme Explainer Guides

- [What Do The Memes About Hearing Saxophones In The Hood Mean?](https://trending.knowyourmeme.com/editorials/guides/what-do-the-memes-about-hearing-saxophones-in-the-hood-mean-the-viral-90s-hood-movie-trend-explained): Guide explaining Boyz n the Hood saxophone meme trend on TikTok/Instagram
- [Who Is The 'Bananas And Rice' Girl?](https://trending.knowyourmeme.com/editorials/guides/who-is-the-bananas-and-rice-girl-the-viral-memes-about-somali-american-ice-victim-nasra-ahmed-explained): Guide explaining Nasra Ahmed 'Bananas and Rice' viral meme from ICE incident

## Subscription & Services

- [Be in Awe of the World. Read SciAm.](https://scientificamerican.com/getsciam): Scientific American subscription pricing page with digital & print plans
